episodes.plot: The oblivious Ms. Blumfeld turns into a superhero, stopping crimes around the city, as Duke struggles with his orders to arrest her.

episodes.plot: It's Harl Hubbs Day and Harl decided to help the whole city, but quickly discovers he isn't prepared for Harl mania

episodes.plot: Billy's mother, Ann, accepts a junkyard race challenge against the city's street racing legend, Tread Octane.

episodes.name: L'uomo venuto dal West
episodes.plot: It’s an old west showdown, when a new adversary rolls into town.

episodes.name: L'unione fa la forza
episodes.plot: Fendrich organizes a charity as a distraction while he attempts to steal the city deed. Sinclair gathers antiheroes to stop him.

episodes.name: Freya torna a scuola
episodes.plot: Freya is one credit short of graduating from the fire academy and is suspended as Fire Chief.

episodes.name: Il candidato divertente
episodes.plot: Mayor Fleck is running for re-election against R E Fendrich who will stop at nothing to win to use his new power to defeat Sinclair once and for all.

episodes.name: Dirty Duke
episodes.plot: When Duke loses his memory, Snake Rattler tricks him into believing he's Snake’s criminal henchman.

episodes.name: Per Wheeler
episodes.plot: When Rooky discovers it’s Chief Wheeler’s birthday, she is determined to make it a memorable.

episodes.name: Il quacken
episodes.plot: During the dedication ceremony of the city’s deep sea vessel to honor Duke, Freya and Harl, the ship is accidentally set adrift.

episodes.name: Il tesoro di Nosepatch
episodes.plot: When the mythical ocean monster, the Quacken, is sighted off the coast, famed adventurer Jessica Sharpe vows to capture it.

episodes.name: L'ettagono delle Bermuda
episodes.plot: Rooky and Grizzled go undercover aboard the Guardian of the Oceans in search of a lost pirate treasure.

episodes.name: Festosi gentiluomini siete in arresto
episodes.plot: Fendrich and his gang learn of Cluster’s hidden junkyard treasure. Harl Cluster, Shirley and Tread unite to protect it.

episodes.name: Buon giro, ragazzo
episodes.plot: Snake and Daisy take advantage of Tread to get him to act as their getaway driver to pull off a heist.

episodes.name: Teodora Nakosto
episodes.plot: When Fendrich threatens to ruin Sinclair's Holiday Gala, Duke intervenes to save both the party and the holidays.

episodes.name: Tread non arriva mai secondo!
episodes.plot: Freya takes Billy and Mark on a ride along, but when things get out of hand, it's up to Mark to save the day.

episodes.name: Grazie, Hank
episodes.plot: Tired of the constant disrespect, Hacksaw Hank quits Fendrich's crew and goes to work for Mary Sinclair.

episodes.name: I ragazzi stanno guardando?
episodes.plot: Lt. Gracie Goodhart joins an Officer Exchange Programme and rivals Duke's standing as City's most beloved police officer.

episodes.name: Detective Shirley
episodes.plot: News anchor Craig Woodman goes missing, Gabby Tocamera desperately turns to Shirley Keeper for help.

episodes.name: Saluti e morsi
episodes.plot: When the city's power grid overloads, Master Architect, Ave Empire must save the day - if he can prove that he is not a vampire.

episodes.name: Un colpo di classe
episodes.plot: When student’s computer tablets go missing, Detectives Grizzled and Partnur go undercover as a student and a teacher to catch the thief.

episodes.name: Siamo i migliori
episodes.plot: "The Police vs Fire charity turns from good-natured to angry after competitive Tread Octane is brought in as a last minute replacement."

episodes.name: Il risveglio di Wylde
episodes.plot: After thawing his best friend, Dr. Wylde, Dr. Wexler must help Wylde adjust to this modern, one-year-later world.

episodes.name: Affari esplosivi
episodes.plot: Tired of living with her overbearing mother, Daisy starts her own business in order to buy a dynamite factory as a new hideout.

episodes.name: Fare e disfare
episodes.plot: With the help of Harl Hubbs' giant crane, Ave Empire is determined to put his opera house in the perfect spot in the city.

episodes.name: Luci! Motore! Grizzled!
episodes.plot: Detective Sam Grizzled is hired as a consultant on a movie about an action-packed bank robbery he foiled in his early police days.

episodes.name: Le ferie di Duke
episodes.plot: When an exhausted Duke Detain makes an uncharacteristic mistake on duty, he volunteers to take his first-ever day off.

episodes.name: Harpy Stubbs
episodes.plot: An unlikely friendship develops between Poppy Starr, the world's biggest pop star, and Harl Hubbs, the city's humble, helpful handyman.

episodes.name: Il valore del coraggio
episodes.plot: In order to save a newspaper, Maddy becomes intrepid reporter, Nomi D. Plume and uses her anonymity as a kid to break exclusive scoops.

episodes.name: Luce verde
episodes.plot: Fendrich tries to steal a high-tech device being transported to the Eco-Power Plant. Wheeler sends the reluctant Alan to stop him.

episodes.name: Una zia fortissima
episodes.plot: Freya’s quest to have fun with her nephew goes out of control when she reconnects with the inner-wild child she spent years learning to suppress.

episodes.name: La mucca bipede delle pianure
episodes.plot: Westbrook W. Sleet tracks the mysterious Standing Cow of the Lowlands, which he believes is loose in the city – which could create havoc.

episodes.name: Una città acrobatica
episodes.plot: The stunt team shows up in the city ready to dazzle, they see the daily action around the city and realize they need to up their game.

episodes.name: Padri e figli
episodes.plot: Chief Wheeler’s stern, uptight father comes to the city with plans to invest in the big stunt show Wheeler loves.

episodes.name: Uno scherzo per Fleck
episodes.plot: When the mysterious Prankster mails Mayor Fleck a threat to prank him in public, Carol asks Duke to be the reluctant mayor’s bodyguard.

episodes.name: Miglioramenti
episodes.plot: Fire Marshal Finn McCormack’s small town ways clash with the chaotic city and decides safety changes need to be made to the new stunt show.

episodes.name: Diamogli una mano
episodes.plot: Billy and Maddy join a kid’s citywide obstacle course with the help of the stunt team.

episodes.name: Habitat naturale
episodes.plot: Gabby Tocamera hosts a documentary about the green city and finds a mystery surrounding the disappearance of the beloved sewer dolphins.

seasons.name: Stagione 4
seasons.plot: A school assignment to find out whose family founded and still owns the City sends Billy and Maddy across town on adventures with old friends and new faces. Ultimately, they not only learn about their City, but must save it!

episodes.name: Rissa al municipio
episodes.plot: Saving Maddy’s mom when the City Hall security system runs amok, Billy and Maddy find a clue to the City founder’s identity.

episodes.name: Chi è Ludmilla Ersatz?
episodes.plot: With help from the kids, Daisy "Kaboom" Lewis creates an alter ego to take the blame for her past mis-deeds, but two identities prove hard to maintain.

episodes.name: Emergenza sulla base lunare Momentous!
episodes.plot: Billy must save his astronaut hero when Captain Momentous hallucinates an alien invasion after eating expired astronaut food.

episodes.name: Guida spericolata
episodes.plot: Billy and Maddy must help Stunt Driver Wallop pass a safe driving course, or risk being banned from City streets forever.

episodes.name: Una casa divisa
episodes.plot: Cultures clash when the fire department moves in temporarily with the police department following damage to their station.

episodes.name: L'inganno della Slooshie
episodes.plot: The Ice Cream Truck Bandits waylay the police force with frozen drinks, giving the officers Glacial Brain Freeze.

episodes.name: Nata per fare la regista
episodes.plot: Maddy's filmmaking ambitions go wild when she offers to direct a fire safety video.

episodes.name: La congettura della deviazione di Wexler
episodes.plot: Depressed, Dr. Wexler quits science. But when a meteor threatens the City, Billy and Maddy must persuade him back!

translations.value: La congettura della deviazione di Wexler

episodes.name: Billy al massimo
episodes.plot: Billy worries he won’t meet his Mom’s expectations when she signs them up for a charity event’s team physical challenges.

episodes.name: Il buono, il cattivo… e le tartarughe
episodes.plot: Maddy takes in two lost turtles, unaware that they belong to rivals Sinclair and Fendrich, who believe she's kidnapped them.

translations.value: Il buono, il cattivo… e le tartarughe

episodes.name: Una giornata con Dread
episodes.plot: With their best friends out of town, Maddy and Dread spend the day together and struggle to find common ground.

episodes.name: Mr. Produce compra una fattoria
episodes.plot: After buying a farm to grow his own produce, Mr. Produce becomes convinced neighbouring farmers are out to get him.

episodes.name: Il terreno appartiene a Harl
episodes.plot: Fendrich and Sinclair forge an unlikely alliance to try and drive Harl off a piece of undeveloped land he owns.

episodes.name: Shirley su di giri
episodes.plot: Shirley Keeper infiltrates the city's underworld to retrieve the secret formula for Vita Rush's new flavour.

episodes.name: Sì, no, forse
episodes.plot: To build an environmentally-unfriendly factory, Fendrich preys on Mayor Fleck's need to be liked to approve his project.

episodes.name: Il vecchio partner
episodes.plot: Detective Grizzled's first partner of bad habits returns to the City, causing frustration for his current partner, Rooky.

episodes.name: Tornare alle basi
episodes.plot: The kids notice that Freya is in a rut when it comes to making firefighting decisions, so they help her get her groove back.

episodes.name: Che fine ha fatto il capo Wheeler?
episodes.plot: When they learn Fendrich owns the city, the kids need Chief Wheeler's help, but he may have magically turned into a sheep.

translations.value: Che fine ha fatto il capo Wheeler?

episodes.name: Re Fendrich I
episodes.plot: Billy, Maddy, and friends resist Fendrich's iron rule and desperately try to prove that he does not, in fact, own the city.

episodes.name: Re Fendrich II
episodes.plot: Moments before Fendrich can tear down city hall, Billy and Maddy learn the shocking truth of who owns the city.
